Double or Nothing

by: Mattie Rynkiewicz

formation: Quadruple minor becket

A1 8
long lines forward & back
8
right left through (straight across), face partner up & down
A2 16
partners start a full hey - lefts on ends, rights in center (this hey is UP & DOWN with trail buddy couple)
B1 16
partners balance & swing
B2 8
partners promenade major set ccw two places to new neighbors ⁋
8
circle right 4 places (halfway)

For another quadruple minor dance, see https://contradb.com/dances/3290

This may be the first quadruple minor becket dance in existence.

TO GET IN FORMATION
1) hands four becket
2) take hands eight (up & down)
3) identify trail buddy couple

Trail buddy couples get zigzaged as they progress.
Left-side couples zero progress.
Right-side couples double progress.

Alternate wording if that didn't make sense - 1s & 3s progress up, 2s & 4s progress down. 1s & 3s / 2s & 4s swap roles each time. 1s & 4s zero progress, 2s & 3s double progress.

END EFFECT CHOREO - FOUR OUT
B2
8 [major set] promenade ccw, face trail buddies
8 circle R once
A
8 long lines forward & back
8 right left thru
A2
16 whole hey, ladles pass R
B
16 partner balance & swing

shared everywhere
